1–2 hours (depends on your luck with the rare orc)

{npc:Sam}, the blacksmith of Thais, lost his old adventurer's backpack in an orc attack at Ulderek's Rock. Find it on a rare orc in the Orc Fortress, return it to Sam and he sends you to his friend {npc:Kroox}, in Kazordoon, who lets you fetch a {item:Dwarven Armor} from the dwarven mines.
Sam, the blacksmith of Thais, was once an avid explorer and lost his backpack on one of his adventures.
Minimum level 35 to open the quest door (40+ recommended).
Premium is not required: everything is done in a Free zone.
A melee weapon (or any weapon) to cut through the {item:Spider Web|spider webs} on the way to the chest.
to get out of the holes in the mines
or equivalent, for the holes in the Dwarf Mines
Bring an empty backpack to the Orc Fortress: the rare orc drops Sam's backpack and you want room for the loot.
Open the {item:Old and Used Backpack} and take everything out of it before handing it in: Sam throws away any item that is inside.
The {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} in the mines are dangerous for low levels. If you are level 40–50, go with a friend or use {wiki:Invisible|invisibility} and run.
1. Finding Sam's backpack in the Orc Fortress
The backpack was stolen by an orc. Only one specific orc, which rarely appears in the north-east corner of the Orc Fortress (Ulderek's Rock), can drop it.
Going to the Orc Powder tower

Travel to the **Orc Fortress** ({wiki:Ulderek's Rock|Ulderek's Rock}), north-west of Venore and east of Kazordoon: the simplest way is to take a boat to **Venore** and walk **north-west**. Inside the fortress, head for the **north-east** tip, next to the tower where the {item:Orc Powder} is. This is where the rare orc that carries the backpack spawns.
Rare orc spawn (near the Orc Powder tower)
Spawn location of the orc that has Sam's backpack
The fortress is full of {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} and {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}. Do not pull too many at once.

Kill the {creature:Orc|orcs} that appear at that spot until one of them drops the {item:Old and Used Backpack}. The backpack is **red, embroidered** with the message *"Property of Sam, Thais."*. It may take a while: the orc is a rare spawn, so it keeps respawning at the spot.
Take all the items out of the backpack as soon as you have it.
With the backpack, leave the fortress the way you came in and walk back **south-east** to Venore. From there take the boat to **Thais** ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).

Go back to **Thais** and go to {npc:Sam}'s weapon shop. With the backpack in your inventory, say {key:hi}, then {key:backpack} and confirm twice with {key:yes}. You earn the **Backpack Tourist** achievement and Sam asks you to go and see his friend {npc:Kroox} in Kazordoon.

Travel to **Kazordoon**, the dwarf city inside the mountain, **east** of Thais (go on foot, or by the {wiki:Steamship|steamship} from Cormaya or Farmine). Look for {npc:Kroox}'s armor shop (Kroox Quality Armor), on floor -2 of the city. Say {key:hi} and then {key:Sam sent me}. Kroox has no armors in stock, but he gives you permission to go and get one from the mines.
4. Getting the Dwarven Armor in the Dwarf Mines
Going down to the Crusader Helmet Quest area

Bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}. The {wiki:Dwarf Mines|Pick 'N Shovel Mine} is the green mine, with its entrance **west** of Kazordoon. Go in, head **east** and go down the hole; go straight down another hole and head well to the **west**; go **north** and **west** and go down one more hole. There, head **east** (there are {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}), go **north** and pass the **level 35** expertise door; go down the next hole to the spider tunnel, the site of the {wiki:Crusader Helmet Quest}. On the way you will meet about three {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} (there are four in the cave) and several {item:Spider Web|webs} that you have to cut with your weapon.
The Giant Spiders poison and hit hard. Bring health potions and antidotes (or the {spell:Cure Poison} spell).
Entrance to the Pick 'N Shovel Mine
Ground floor of the Dwarf Mines with the 6 entrances (the Pick 'N Shovel is the green one, E)
Opening the quest door and the chest

**Before** you reach the Crusader Helmet spot, follow a passage that goes **south**. You find a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door} (needs level 35) with a {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} inside. Open the door, go in and open the chest to receive your {item:Dwarven Armor}.
Quest door and chest with the Dwarven Armor

Go back the same way: return to the spider tunnel, climb up with the {item:Rope} through the holes you came down, pass the level 35 door again and retrace the mine in reverse to the entrance of the Pick 'N Shovel Mine, west of Kazordoon.
Entrance/exit of the Pick 'N Shovel Mine
You can only do this quest **once** per character.
If the orc drops another {item:Old and Used Backpack}, you can use it as a normal container, do the quest on another character or sell it to another player.
